hard_calls: The statement 'To take in the importance of Peirce's principle...' is kept with the Ostwald note as the lead-in to the concrete application, rather than with the Peirce note; it names Peirce's principle so it stands alone.
Footnote 23 (a clause from the earlier 'What Pragmatism Means' section) stays in the 'nothing new' note because the clause is part of the same sentence as footnote 22.
'That is, the rival views mean practically the same thing...' stays in the Ostwald note since it glosses the quoted passage and cannot stand alone.
